sn55.7:3.1: “Relevant for oneself” is _attupanāyika_, where _upanāyika_ is a form of _opaneyyika_, a standard epithet of the Dhamma. The root sense is “leading near”, but here we see that the applied sense is “applicable to oneself”, i.e. “relevant”. See also [thag1.1:1.4]().
sn55.7:7.2: Here, in the context of false speech, _attha_ means “meaning” rather than “welfare”.
sn55.7:9.2: BB has “address”, but samudacarati usually has a negative sense of “beset, plague”, etc.
